obligations.source_text: A declared-fictional near-future photographic crime reconstruction showing robbery as a forced property-transfer relation: one adult offender compels a distinct adult courier through a directed crowbar threat while taking the same case from the courier's control, with a reference-guided adult station investigator remaining a secondary supporting witness.

bindings.offender_phrase: one adult offender initiates the taking and controls the coercive action; in this frame he grips the same red leather case
bindings.owner_phrase: one specific adult victim visibly owns holds or guards the targeted property; the courier grips the red case handle against her body
bindings.coercion_phrase: force or a credible directed threat compels the victim during the taking; the raised steel crowbar points toward the courier
bindings.transfer_phrase: cash bag phone wallet or other property visibly moves from victim control toward offender control; the same red leather chronometer case crosses between their opposed hands
